verdict.rationale: Synctera publishes an API reference at /v2/reference/... endpoints and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json. Sandbox API keys let developers start calling the APIs immediately, so examples can be run against a sandbox. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive (e.g., an in-browser 'try it' console) or that it ships runnable code samples. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-page interactive request console, runnable code examples within the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
